1. Policy Purpose and Guiding Philosophy
Apex Global Technologies believes that rest, recuperation, and personal time are critical to sustained engineering
productivity, cognitive clarity, and overall well-being. This policy outlines entitlements, accrual rules, and approval
procedures for all categories of leave.
2. Paid Time Off (PTO) / Annual Vacation Leave
Full-time permanent employees are entitled to paid annual leave to recharge and attend to personal matters:
Annual Entitlement: Twenty (20) business days of paid vacation per calendar year (accrued at the rate of 1.67
days per full calendar month worked).
Accrual Commencement: Accrual begins on the employee's first official day of employment. Leave may be
requested once accrued.
Rollover Rules: Up to five (5) unused PTO days may be carried over into the following calendar year. Any
carried-over days must be utilized before March 31st of the new calendar year, after which they expire without
cash payout, unless mandated otherwise by local employment regulations.
Separation Payout: Upon voluntary separation or termination, accrued and unused PTO days are paid out in the
final paycheck based on the employee's current daily base salary rate.
3. Sick and Medical Leave
Apex provides dedicated paid sick leave to ensure employees prioritize recovery without financial worry:
Annual Allowance: Ten (10) paid sick days per calendar year, credited on January 1st (or prorated for mid-year
joiners). Sick leave does not accrue month-by-month and does not roll over.
Medical Certificate Requirement: If an employee is absent due to illness for more than two (2) consecutive
business days, a verified medical certificate signed by a licensed healthcare practitioner must be submitted to
People Operations upon return.
Emergency Medical Leave: For prolonged hospitalization or critical health conditions, employees may apply for
Short-Term Disability (STD) or Family and Medical Leave (FMLA), providing up to 12 weeks of job-protected leave.

5. Parental, Family Care, and Civic Leave
Primary Caregiver Parental Leave: Sixteen (16) weeks of 100% fully paid leave following the birth, adoption, or
foster placement of a child. Available to all employees with at least 6 months of continuous service.
Secondary Caregiver Parental Leave: Four (4) weeks of 100% fully paid parental leave, exercisable within 12
months of the qualifying event.
Bereavement Leave: Up to five (5) consecutive paid days for immediate family members (spouse, child, parent,
sibling); up to three (3) paid days for extended family.
Jury Duty & Civic Responsibility: Up to ten (10) business days of paid leave to attend mandatory jury duty or
legal witness subpoenas upon submission of the court summons.
6. Leave Application and Approval Workflow
Standard Leave Application Procedure
Submission: All leave requests must be logged through the BambooHR Self-Service Portal.
Advance Notice: For planned leaves of three (3) or more consecutive days, requests must be submitted at least
fourteen (14) calendar days in advance. For single-day PTO, at least forty-eight (48) hours notice is required.
Manager Approval: Direct managers must review and act on leave requests within forty-eight (48) business
hours. Managers may only decline leave in writing based on critical project release freezes.
Unplanned / Emergency Absences: In cases of sudden illness or emergency, notify your direct manager and
post in your team's Slack channel before 08:30 AM local time.
